# Registry API Reference

The **`registry`** namespace, available to **server** and **client** scripts. Query the game registries to see whether an item/block/entity/fluid exists and to list the ids other mods registered. Ids without a namespace default to `minecraft:`.

This is read-only discovery - a sandbox-preserving window onto the game's content, with no reflection into other mods.

---

## `registry.block_exists(id)`

Whether a block with the given id is registered. A bare id defaults to `minecraft:`.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | - | The block id, e.g. `"stone"`. |

---

## `registry.blocks(namespace = None)`

The ids of every registered block, sorted. Pass a `namespace` to list only one mod's blocks.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | any | no | `None` | A mod id to filter by, or `None` (the default) for all blocks. |

---

## `registry.entities(namespace = None)`

The ids of every registered entity type, sorted. Pass a `namespace` to list only one mod's.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | any | no | `None` | A mod id to filter by, or `None` (the default) for all entity types. |

---

|---|---|---|---|---|

## `registry.item_exists(id)`

Whether an item with the given id is registered. A bare id defaults to `minecraft:`.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | - | The item id, e.g. `"diamond"` or `"create:cogwheel"`. |

## `registry.items(namespace = None)`

The ids of every registered item, sorted. Pass a `namespace` to list only one mod's items, e.g. `registry.items("minecraft")`.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `namespace` | any | no | `None` | A mod id to filter by, or `None` (the default) for all items. |
